product: SmartCiti.X : Trade Craft Academy (powered by AGI Corp)
honesty: Quests, games, treasures, easter eggs and badges are play: they are kept on this device only, they are never evidence of anything, and they never enter a completion record.

quests.title: Signal caller
quests.hint: Give the signal the lift card calls, in order, before the clock runs out; finish on STOP.
quests.unlock_text: To unlock: walk "Call the first lift before anybody touches the hook", "Walk where the bundle will fly before it flies".

quests.title: Chart or refuse
quests.hint: Judge each pick against the chart line at its radius: hook it or refuse it.
quests.unlock_text: To unlock: walk "Refuse the pick the chart refuses".

quests.title: Cut to grade
quests.hint: Take each trench cell to its marked depth, stop the flagged cell shallow, dump in the spoil zone.
quests.unlock_text: To unlock: walk "Prove what is under the ground before the bucket moves", "Read the ground again after the rain".

quests.title: Crib match
quests.hint: Read what a tool is for and pick it off the crib wall.
quests.unlock_text: To unlock: walk "Frame it for whoever comes next", "Cut a joint without wrecking the brick".

quests.title: Report in at the quest board
quests.hint: Open the quest board and press "Report in".

quests.title: Call the first card
quests.hint: Walk the riggers' first lesson, then come back to the board.
quests.unlock_text: To unlock: walk "Call the first lift before anybody touches the hook"; finish "Report in at the quest board".

quests.title: Call the lift
quests.hint: Win a round of Signal caller in the arcade.
quests.unlock_text: To unlock: finish "Call the first card", "Signal caller".

quests.title: Read the chart before the pick
quests.hint: Win a round of Chart or refuse in the arcade.
quests.unlock_text: To unlock: finish "Call the lift", "Chart or refuse".

quests.title: Dig to grade, miss the utility
